title: ASB Capital launches global multi-asset fund with Principal Asset Management
summary: Providing investors with diversified global exposure across multiple asset classes through a single offering

contentHtml:
The launch supports ASB Capital's strategy to develop investment solutions aligned with clients' income, diversification, and liquidity requirements. Image Courtesy: ASB Capital

Providing investors with diversified global exposure across multiple asset classes through a single offering

Press Release

ASB Capital, a purpose-driven asset and wealth management firm with assets under management (AUM) of USD 10.2 billion, announced the launch of the ASB Principal Multi-Asset Fund (the Fund) in partnership with Principal Asset Management®. The Fund is designed to provide investors with diversified global exposure across multiple asset classes through a single offering.

The ASB Principal Multi-Asset Fund invests in equities, fixed income, and private markets offering investors a broader approach to diversification. Through the partnership, the Fund combines ASB Capital's investment platform and client reach with the global asset allocation capabilities and investment expertise of Principal.  

The launch supports ASB Capital's strategy to develop investment solutions aligned with clients' income, diversification, and liquidity requirements. It also provides clients with an accessible core portfolio solution to obtain diversified exposure across markets, asset classes, and investment strategies.

Commenting on the launch, Rafik Nayed, Managing Director of ASB Capital, said: “The ASB Principal Multi-Asset Fund has been designed for investors seeking diversified global exposure through a single, actively managed solution. Rather than requiring clients to construct and continuously manage allocations across separate funds and securities, the Fund brings these exposures together within a disciplined investment framework that can respond to changing market conditions.”

He added: “Our partnership with Principal combines its global investment and asset-allocation capabilities with ASB Capital’s platform and comprehensive product suite. The inclusion of both public markets and selected private-market opportunities expands the investment universe available to clients and represents another important step in building a comprehensive range of solutions across different risk profiles and investment horizons”.

“Effective multi-asset investing requires investors to draw on a broad opportunity set and actively assess where risk-adjusted returns can be found across public and private markets. Through this collaboration, ASB Capital can access the global asset allocation expertise and specialist investment teams across equities, fixed income and private markets offered by Principal to help deliver a diversified solution tailored to the needs of investors in the Middle East,” said Thomas Cheong, Executive Vice President of Principal Financial Group and President of Asia Pacific and Middle East.”

 The launch further expands ASB Capital’s investment platform across public and private markets and reinforces its objective of delivering managed solutions aligned with clients’ evolving portfolio-allocation requirements.

About Principal Asset Management®  

With public and private market capabilities across all asset classes, Principal Asset Management and its investment specialists look at asset management through a different lens, creating solutions to help deliver client investment objectives. By applying local insights with global perspectives, Principal Asset Management identifies distinct and compelling investment opportunities for more than 1,100 institutional clients in over 80 markets.1 Principal Asset Management is the global investment solutions business for Principal Financial Group® (Nasdaq: PFG), managing $601.9 billion in assets2 and recognized as a “Best Places to Work in Money Management”3 for 14 consecutive years.  

Learn more at www.PrincipalAM.com    

[1] Pensions & Investments, “The Largest Real Estate Investment Managers,” 10 November 2025.

[2] As of June 30, 2026.

[3] Pensions & Investments, “The Best Places to Work in Money Management” among companies with 1,000 or more employees, December 2025.
